ANIMATED PREVIEW
THE PROJECT

What it is and why it exists

An audit-and-rebuild service for teams bleeding money on AI APIs: prompt and context compression, model routing, caching, and local-model offload — with a before/after calculator that proves the delta. The credibility comes from the fact that the same stack runs on this machine, so the numbers are measured rather than theorised.

Highlights

  • Interactive savings calculator (public lead magnet)
  • Local-LLM offload for privacy + zero marginal cost
  • Playbook productized as a paid PDF
HOW IT WORKS

The mechanism end to end

No hand-waving: this is the actual chain, in the order it runs.

01

Baseline

Measure real tokens in and out per workload. Most teams are guessing; the bill is the only honest benchmark.

02

Find the fat

Repeated context in every call, system prompts longer than the task, and frontier models selected for work a small model would do.

03

Compress and route

Cut the context to what the task needs, cache the stable part, and route each call to the cheapest model that can pass its checks.

04

Offload the volume

Deterministic, high-volume work (classification, extraction, formatting) moves to local weights: same result, no per-token fee, no data leaving the machine.

05

Prove it

Re-measure on the same workload and publish the before/after. If the saving is not measurable, it did not happen.

BUILD IT YOURSELF

The steps in order, with the traps

This is the short version of what I would do again — including the parts that bit me first.

01

Instrument first

Log tokens and model per call before changing anything. You cannot optimise a bill you have not attributed.

02

Treat context as a budget

The cheapest token is the one you never send. Stable prefixes should be cached, not re-sent.

03

Route by task, not by habit

Keep a cheap tier for extraction and routing and a frontier tier for judgement, and make the escalation explicit.

04

Offload the boring 80%

High-volume classification and formatting belong on local weights — that also keeps the data home.

05

Re-measure, then publish

A saving you cannot show on a graph is a claim, not a result.

WHAT I LEARNED

Notes from the build

NOTE 01Most of an AI bill is context you did not need and a model that was too big for the job.
NOTE 02Local offload is a privacy feature as much as a cost feature.
NOTE 03Routing is the highest-leverage single change — the spread between tiers is an order of magnitude.
